Bridge $40 of USDC to Bitcoin through Citrea Bridge, then use the funds inside Citrea Bridge's app so the transfer is more than a pass-through. Cost: $40 of capital plus about $12 of gas on Ethereum or a mainnet, where a transaction costs real gas. Time: 15 to 20 minutes to set up.

Move the farming capital to Bitcoin first through an official bridge, not a third-party one, and send a test transfer before the full amount. Cost: $12 to $24 of bridge gas. Time: 20 minutes plus bridge wait.
Move $20 back the other way through Citrea Bridge, so the record shows volume in both directions. Cost: $10 of capital at risk, plus $4 of gas. Time: 10 minutes.

Make one qualifying action each week for the first month - a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a vote - so the wallet's history has more than one cluster. Cost: about $3 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 60 days - the protocol has run 285 days with no token - so the activity lands in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $40 stays locked in the position. Time: 60 days.
Watch the protocol's own announcements for a points program or governance test, and join it the week it opens; the cheap phases are early. Cost: no fee to join. Time: 15 minutes a fortnight.

Before you withdraw, check the protocol's own page for a claim; claim only from a link it publishes, and never pay anyone to unlock an airdrop. Cost: no fee; a claim that asks for payment is a scam. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, dates and every transaction hash in a farm log so you can repeat the position or unwind it cleanly. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.
